label: Book
summary: The full life-story book, compiled from Focus chapters — no fixed slots; readiness is computed live from the chapter map.

research.basis: Chapters-as-slots rather than a fixed slot list because the hybrid thematic-chronological structure (research.md §2a) generates chapters dynamically from the question bank's category map; book.py composes these live using the same READY/DEVELOPING thresholds and scene-slot readiness math as individual chapters, so the book's table of contents evolves as material accumulates instead of being fixed at creation.
citations: research.md §2a — hybrid thematic-chronological structure: chronological backbone, thematic chapters, each needing a central scene, tension, turning point, and reflection
McAdams life-chapters exercise — 2-7 chapters, each titled, each transition articulated, re-run yearly as the book's table of contents evolves
book.py BOOK_DELIVERABLES / READY=0.70 / DEVELOPING=0.40 / WORDS_PER_QUESTION_TARGET=350 — chapter readiness and length are anchored to question-bank density rather than a static slot list
